sync.heading: Keep this benchmark fresh
sync.intro: Every week, merged fixes from {{repo}} become new tasks. Fixes already turned into tasks are skipped.
sync.pickRepo: Enter a repository above to turn on weekly tasks.
sync.private: This repository is private. Its code is read with your GitHub connection on a worker, sent only to your own model key, and stays in your organization. The benchmark is visible to your organization's members only.
